title: XY16 width restoration reloads an overwritten X-writer source
summary: The pre-gate XY16 compiler returns 0xD3BD for vlastack_sim instead of the host/A16 oracle 0xD77B. MOSInsertREPSEP clones an LDX from $rs1 after an index-width narrowing, although intervening stores have replaced $rs1 ($rc2:$rc3) with the vs_nruns destination pointer. The indexed stream read uses that pointer as its offset and every row count becomes 8. No repair or green candidate is claimed.
attribution: Investigation and evidence: OpenAI Codex API agent 0.157.1, exact model ID unknown (GPT-6 family stated by session), reasoning effort unknown; session 01a0e5a0-9b2c-7c81-9f0b-d154ff8783d9. Model ID and reasoning effort were not exposed by session metadata. Earlier work is credited in the linked reports.

prior_work.source_assessment: The live MOSInsertREPSEP::placeIntraBlock implementation and patch 0002 clone LastX16Writer after REP #$10 without checking that its source has not changed. The pre/post pass MIR captures the inserted reload after writes to aliases of its source. The existing Y-index and accumulator-spill repairs have different mechanisms.
prior_work.binary_assessment: The preserved pre-gate clang-23 binary SHA-256 is ff61df1d0569ff3a5cf58a8d67e67c57b5a5fee4024adb2dae5e1b1fbcb7f8d5. Its exact original-source ROM is retained and a rebuild from byte-identical snapshot inputs produced the same ROM SHA-256 cf07749d309debc6a3948022fda2838b966ac7f219dc40be27416b77d473cb39. The compiler version string reports LLVM 23.0.0git and vendor pin 8be0546128a55e78c63ca571d466aa72a782cd36; the September 27 gate receipt records the applied patch-stack identity.
prior_work.decision: This is the first structured record for a distinct stale-source replay introduced by the earlier X high-byte restoration. The carry-pressure record is a scheduler performance issue and only held this as an unisolated observation; the near-Y record repairs a separate Y-index sequence. The June X high-byte report remains historical evidence of its own fixed trigger, while this input exposes a new contract failure in the same restoration routine.

baseline.build_command: dev/container.sh -- build/carry-gate/baseline-install/bin/mos-clang --config build/install/bin/mos-snes.cfg -mcpu=mosw65816 -Xclang -target-feature -Xclang +mos-xy16 -Os -Wl,-Map=build/vlastack-triage/snapshot.map -o build/vlastack-triage/snapshot.sfc docs/defects/evidence/2026-09-28-vlastack-xy16-stale-reload/input/examples/snes/corpus/vlastack_sim.c; python3 tools/snes-checksum.py build/vlastack-triage/snapshot.sfc

unknowns: The repair has not been implemented. A correct restoration must preserve the original X value across the 16-to-8-to-16 width transition even when the prior writer source is subsequently modified; cloned-writer replay is insufficient. The broader effect of the same pattern on other programs is unmeasured. The retained MIR is from an otherwise identical non-LTO compile for pass isolation; the linked LTO object and ROM show the same instruction sequence.
